display_long_description:
JUMPR VR is a next-generation immersive entertainment platform designed for virtual reality.

Experience live events and exclusive VR content like never before. With JUMPR VR, you can watch fights, concerts, sports events and premium shows in stunning 360° immersive video, placing you right in the front row.

Key Features
• Immersive 360° VR video experience
• Live and on-demand premium events
• Front-row perspective for fights, concerts and sports
• High-quality VR streaming
• Private viewing rooms and special experiences

Feel the atmosphere
Instead of watching events on a flat screen, JUMPR VR places you inside the experience. Look around, feel the crowd, and enjoy events from the best seat in the arena.

Exclusive VR Content
JUMPR VR collaborates with creators and event organizers to deliver unique immersive experiences only available in VR.

Next-generation VR entertainment starts here.
